description: Start a step - propose, add, documents, ask or remove - in a private store, with its JSON body, as the manual says. propose stores nothing; add stores only facts the person approved, with propose's proposal_id and their reply as confirmation; remove deletes only with confirm true, after the person confirmed. Returns the step's state: `waiting` (a prompt to do and answer with replyToPrompt), `running` (call getStep), `done` (do what `next` says) or `failed`.

confirm.description: remove: true to delete, after the person confirmed.

confirmation.description: add: the person's approving reply, quoted.

facts.description: add: the approved facts. remove: fact ids, F<n> numbers or exact words.

keep_both.description: add: [new fact, stored fact] pairs the person says are both true.

part_of.description: documents: the first part's document_id, for every later part. Send parts in order, one at a time, each after the previous part's result.

replace.description: add: stored fact ids the person chose to replace.

text.description: propose: the person's message. documents: the document's text, or one part of it - at most the manual's per-call limit; longer text goes in parts.

store.description: The person's private store link, as they gave it: https://.../api/k/<id> or https://.../#/store/<id>. Public links are read-only.

name: startStep
title: Start a step in the person's store
